name: polycli-bridge
description: Lets Cowork tasks work with polycli, the terminal app for Claude Code sessions on this computer: link a task to a workstream, send prompts to its CLI sessions and read the answers, open sessions, and report artifacts. The user approves links and prompts in polycli.

tools.name: polycli_list
tools.description: List workstreams and their Claude Code CLI sessions.

tools.name: polycli_link
tools.description: Ask to link this Cowork task to a workstream; returns a link token.

tools.name: polycli_link_status
tools.description: Check whether the user approved the link.

tools.name: polycli_send
tools.description: Send a prompt to a CLI session (idempotent per client_ref).

tools.name: polycli_read
tools.description: Read the state and response of a sent prompt.

tools.name: polycli_open_session
tools.description: Start a new CLI session in the linked workstream.

tools.name: polycli_add_artifact
tools.description: Report an artifact or document produced for the workstream.
